recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for core reconciliation. Future workflow-researchStudy content changes should be made in HL7/fhir-extensions rather than duplicated in core.
issue_request: FHIR-39656 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and asked to support finding ObservationDefinitions linked to ResearchStudies by using the workflow-researchStudy extension and providing a search parameter for that linkage.
initial_application: The FHIR Extension Pack commit 4c38f99 created SearchParameter-workflow-researchStudy for FHIR-39656, but the original application omitted ObservationDefinition and the core checkout has no active source file for that extension or SearchParameter.
additional_context: The omission was later captured by Applied/Persuasive FHIR-43174, whose Extension Pack commit 8f62007 added ObservationDefinition to both StructureDefinition-workflow-researchStudy and SearchParameter-workflow-researchStudy. FHIR-41308 separately corrected the same SearchParameter expression to DomainResource.extension(...).value. Both related issues already have audit commits on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit for the seed. No core source change was made because the authoritative artifacts live in HL7/fhir-extensions and are already correct there.
